topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The earth gave way under my feet, revealing a box I could not recall hiding beneath the soil. Its surface was weathered, yet the contents were as I had left them, perfectly preserved. Old photographs, a crumpled note, a childhood bracelet—all strangers to my memory. Each item I unearthed felt heavier than the last, as if the weight of forgotten years was pressing down on me. I traced the edges of the paper, my fingers lingering over the faded ink. The day is growing dim, even though the sun is still high, and I find myself reaching for a warmth that has long since faded into the cool of the earth.
